whyItMatters: md5.convert computes MD5 in dart, whose collisions defeat any security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace md5.convert with sha256.convert wherever the digest protects passwords, signatures, or untrusted data.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified md5.convert, and security digests verify under the replacement.
